parameters.clock: evaluate at second bin close; all constituent reports already available
parameters.constructed_offsets: 30/45/60s first report separation; 0/80/200Hz median offsets; WPM median centers 28/36 preserving sample dispersion
parameters.grouping: 10s UTC bins by band and reported simple call, first receipt per normalized family; within-bin 100Hz spread max; groups matched in same band
parameters.limits: constructed source labels by assignment; natural repeated pairs may share families/groups, source sample is exposed and enriched; no production parity or effect inferred
parameters.natural_labels: same vs different reported calls conditional on burst eligibility; split categories descriptive only; no RF identities
parameters.overlap_controls: Interleave and anonymize the two samples; no calls or manual source partition supplied to detector. 0/2/5s onset offsets. Any trailing 2/3/5s interval with >=4 observations and >=2 families is assessable. A gap >=101Hz (<=100Hz within-side spread) or >=4WPM (<=2WPM within-side spread) must separate two families per side. Any alert before event end counts. No alert does not assert a common transmitter.
parameters.selection: up to 100 disjoint same-reported-call pairs/day, <=50Hz and >=3 families per group, 30-60s apart; source counts retained
